summary:
TerraTwin AI is a planetary analog discovery platform that uses NASA satellite data, Geographic Information Systems (GIS), and machine learning to identify locations on Earth with terrain characteristics similar to Mars.

Our project addresses the challenge of discovering terrestrial environments suitable for preliminary planetary exploration research and robotic testing. Instead of relying only on known analog sites, TerraTwin AI automatically discovers and ranks new locations using measurable terrain characteristics.

The platform integrates NASA MOLA Martian topography and observation counts, NASA SRTM Earth elevation data, and Copernicus DEM. It extracts slope, roughness, and relief, then applies Gaussian Weighted Similarity and Nearest Neighbors to rank potential analog sites.

TerraTwin AI currently supports 11 Martian reference regions and has discovered four candidate terrain windows in Egypt's Eastern Desert. The strongest comparison with Jezero Crater achieved a Terrain Similarity Index of 99.22/100.

Through interactive maps, explainable rankings, and scientific data-quality analysis, TerraTwin AI helps researchers identify promising Earth-based testing environments, supporting more informed and accessible preparation for future Mars missions.
